metadata.gate: Gate 7.5B Pass B2 (Results Browser, Artifact Integrity & Live UX)

results_policy.authority_source: Gate 7 local artifacts are authoritative (run_manifest.json, run_state.json, episodes.csv, timing.csv, summary.json, wandb_sync.json, run_integrity.json)
results_policy.primary_metrics_rule: Direct pass-through from summary.json['overall_metrics'] without GUI recalculation
results_policy.diagnostic_metrics_separation: mean_episode_return and episode_return are labeled diagnostic training signals, NOT benchmark ranking scores

integrity_policy.incomplete_run_semantics: RUNNING / INITIALIZING / INTERRUPTED / FAILED runs without final summary are NOT_FINAL, not corrupted

telemetry_policy.telemetry_source: Exclusively LauncherEventV1 messages received via WORKBENCH_PROTOCOL_V1
telemetry_policy.cadence_wording: sampled LauncherEventV1 progress telemetry (sampled every 10 decision steps under current executor)
telemetry_policy.reset_policy: RUN_STARTED resets run buffer; EPISODE_STARTED resets episode trace

scientific_invariant: summary.json is authoritative aggregate result truth. episodes.csv is authoritative episode-row truth. timing.csv is authoritative episode timing truth. run_state.json is authoritative lifecycle truth. run_integrity.json is authoritative final fingerprint declaration. Workbench only reads, verifies, formats, filters, and visualizes; it never becomes the source of those truths.
